Evaluating U at a,b<=R yields the two-site 2x2 occupation matrix and Kac point-potential equations. Its determinant yields [1+As+Bt+eta ABst]^{-1}. Differentiation gives covariance (1-eta)AB, z*coth(z) monotonicity gives strict r monotonicity, and eta->0 yields (E,E). Independent 27 Green/resolvent checks passed; actual scale is occupation time density, not Tanaka semimartingale local time.
